assay_substrate.name: citral

negative_substrate_result: The three enzymes did not convert geraniol to citronellol or another tested pathway intermediate.
interpretation: Direct in-vitro mixture-substrate evidence in another plant. R percentages are complements of reported S percentages, not independent measurements. NADH distributions must not be assigned to NADPH assays. Geranial/NADP+ structural modeling is not a substrate-specific activity assay.
next_checks: Resolve each citral isomer experimentally or with separately characterized source evidence.
